title: Bay Areas Biggest Diwali Celebration For Singles
description: Illuminate Your Diwali with Bay Area's Biggest Singles Bash
long_description:
Illuminate Your Diwali with Bay Area's Biggest Singles Bash
Mark your calendars as the 7th of November, 2026, brings to you the Bay Area's Biggest DIWALI Celebration for SINGLES. This vibrant event, organized by Gem Social (GemSocialEvents), is an extravaganza of food, drink, and culture. It's not just a Diwali celebration; it's a melting pot of Hindi, English, and Multilingual performances, with an exhibition, singing and dancing to keep you entertained all evening.
Artistic Essence of the Event
While the event doesn't feature a specific artist, the real artists are you, the attendees! The stage is set for everyone to showcase their unique talents. Whether you are a singer, a dancer, or a charismatic conversationalist, your presence is the real essence of this event. This DIWALI celebration is designed to celebrate the diversity and talent among us.
Experience the Charm of Evergreen Valley High School
The event will be held at the Evergreen Valley High School, located at 3300 Quimby Rd, San Jose, CA, United States. The venue is renowned for its safety and accessibility. Its location in the heart of San Jose offers attendees numerous nearby attractions to explore. Parking won't pose a problem, and for those who'd like to indulge in authentic Indian cuisine, there are several noteworthy Indian restaurants in the vicinity.
Your Ticket to the Celebration
Make sure you don't miss out on this golden opportunity. We have various ticket options available. The Early Bird ticket price is just $20.00. If you're coming with friends, take advantage of our Group of 5 offer, with tickets at $18 per person. General Admission is priced at $90.00. For kids between the ages of 5-13, tickets are priced at $16.00, while kids under the age of 5 enter for free. And if you missed the Early Bird offer, don't worry, the Regular Price is just $25.00.
